description: This file defines the 'Font' class responsible for representing font styling in the PHPSpreadsheet library's XLS writer component. It includes methods for setting font properties, generating binary font records, and mapping style attributes like bold and underline to BIFF codes.

classes.name: Font
classes.description: Represents and manages font styling information for the XLS writer in PHPSpreadsheet.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Font object with a given style font.

methods.name: setColorIndex
methods.description: Sets the color index for the font.

methods.name: writeFont
methods.description: Generates the binary font record data for writing into an XLS file.

methods.name: mapBold
methods.description: Maps a boolean bold value to the BIFF font weight code.

methods.name: mapUnderline
methods.description: Maps a PHPSpreadsheet underline style to the corresponding BIFF code.
